description: Get the contents of one file from a GitLab project. `ref` defaults to the default branch. `encoding` is `utf8` when a UTF-8 round-trip test passes, else `base64`; binaries with valid UTF-8 bytes (e.g. 0x00) also pass. Read `encoding`, don't infer it. Directories are not supported: use `get_repository_tree`.

file_path.description: Path to the file (not a directory). Takes precedence over 'path' when both are provided

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path (optional; falls back to env)

name: get_file_contents
